## Draft stub — planned contents
Students build their tool with the assistant against their own plan and tests, one piece at a time, keeping the prompt journal that records where the assistant was wrong and how they caught it. Pairs with the delegating-a-whole-job note. Verification follows the authorship split: functions the student wrote get tests, and any library output gets a sanity check against a value already known.
:::
